card.title: 27e DIA
card.text: Deal 2 damage to the enemy HQ when the enemy draws a RESISTANCE order.
card.flavorText: When war was declared in 1939, the French Army's 27e Division d’Infanterie Alpine (27e DIA) was part of the 6th Army, tasked with defending the Alpine front. In early 1940, several of its battalions of Chasseurs Alpins, forming the 27e Demi-Brigade de Chasseurs Alpins, were assigned to the French Expeditionary Corps in Scandinavia. They took part in the Norwegian Campaign following the German invasion and notably participated in the Battle of Narvik, the first military victory of the Allied forces in WWII. After the start of the Battle of France, they re-embarked to fight on French soil. The remainder of the division was attached to the 7th Army Corps of the 8th Army, tasked with defending a sector of the Maginot Line in north-eastern France. It was engaged in violent fighting on Mont-de-Soissons on June 8th. Following the disbanding of the Armistice army in 1942, many mountain soldiers joined the resistance. During the Liberation, the 27e DIA was the first major unit reconstituted from the Maquis, in September 1944. It was first tasked with protecting the liberated valleys, and later took part in the offensive in the Alps from March 23rd to April 28th, 1945, pushing back the Germans who still held the passes and advancing into Italy.
